title: ゼノギアス
sources: The harness alone, from the game's disc (docs/first-script.md): no reader's snapshots, no memory written
The table: the codes of messages the game was showing, beside the characters read on screen. No second reader has read it, and no font was read

Played from power-on through the opening's narration, the first scene and the hero's room: 14 screens with text over 3 scenes. The script's output was not compared with the screens by `compare`: the work stopped at its budget before the bar (about 30 screens over 3 scenes)
notes: Read by the script games/ps1/SLPS-01160.lua: a window's pointer walks through a message as it types, and the message is said once the pointer stands on its end, with who speaks from its first row. The table has 144 codes: most kanji come out as U+FFFD. Not checked: the second disc (SLPS-01161), several windows at once, choices, fights, menus. A state loaded after a window has closed says its last message again.
